Get In Loser, We're Stealing the Kilogram
takes place during the World Middle School Science Fair, with the eponymous model kilogram as its centerpiece. This game tells two stories:

, a heist crew preparing for their final big score, but there's a hitch. Your wheelman ghosted you the day of the job. You have the training, but you'll have to make do with gadgets scrounged from the middle school science fair.
, a well-bonded set of middle schoolers who just found a bag of spy gear. Summer break is coming up, and wouldn't nabbing that cool kilogram be a great way to send yourselves off?
Play the two teams against each other in an epic and wacky adventure.
is on the case, and she's hot on your trail!
Can you nab the kilogram and get out before Detective Jenny and the authorities close in?

is a oneshot heist ttrpg designed to be played in one of 3 possible runs, as described above. The dice mechanic is simple but intuitive. You want to hit the center of your dice's range (so a 5 and a 6 on a d10). The GJG gets more dice to represent their chaos, but the IA gets better but less dice to represent the focus of their training. Skills and gear vary thematically between the overgeared adolescents and the improvising professionals.
